predecessors.name: Estonian Soviet Socialist Republic
predecessors.text: the Estonian SSR, into which 'Estonia was annexed by the Soviet Union' on 6 August 1940; independence was restored on 20 August 1991

predecessors.name: Estonia (1918-1940)
predecessors.text: the interwar republic, whose 'legal continuity ... was preserved through the government-in-exile'

ledger.x: 1991, 20 August: Estonia declares the restoration of independence.
1991, 20 August: independence restored against Soviet rule.
1991, 6 September: the Soviet Union recognises Estonia.

wars.name: Singing Revolution
wars.outcome: Independence restored on 20 August 1991 and recognised by the Soviet authorities on 6 September 1991; the sovereignty declaration of 16 November 1988 began it.
